[[Estadio Gran Canaria]] (Las Palmas) | pushpin_map = Canary Islands | pushpin_label1 = '''Tenerife''' | pushpin_label1_position = Right | pushpin_label2 = '''Las Palmas''' | pushpin_label2_position = Left | coordinates1 = {{Coord|28|27|47|N|16|15|38|W|region:ES-CN_type:landmark_source:dewiki}} | coordinates2 = {{coord|28|06|00|N|15|27|24|W|region:ES-CN_type:landmark_source:dewiki}} | pushpin_mark1 = Blue pog.svg | pushpin_mark2 = Yellow pog.svg }} The '''Canary Islands derby''' is any [[Association football|football]] match contested between Spanish sides [[UD Las Palmas]] and [[CD Tenerife]], who are regarded as the top two sides in the [[Canary Islands]]. World Soccer Magazine rated it as one of the 50 greatest rivalries in the world, and it is considered one of the most important derbies in Spain. == History == The two teams, based on different islands, have been the Canary Islands' top two sides virtually since their establishment. Both sides have experienced spells in Spain's top division, [[La Liga]]. UD Las Palmas' greatest successes came in the 1960s and 70s, in a period when they came runners-up in La Liga just behind [[Real Madrid]] and in the Spanish Cup (losing to [[FC Barcelona]] in the final), competing in the [[Inter-Cities Fairs Cup]] (now [[UEFA Europa League]]) in 1969, and [[UEFA cup]] two times in 1972 and 1977. Tenerife's greatest successes came in the 1990s; they recorded their best ever league finish in [[1992–93 La Liga|1992–93]] and in [[1995–96 La Liga|1995–96]], in which they finished 5th. In 1996–97, they reached the semi-finals of the [[1996–97 UEFA Cup|UEFA Cup]], losing to eventual winners [[Schalke 04]]. The first contested match between the two took place under peculiar circumstances in the wake of Las Palmas's formation from its five constituent clubs. For only the [[1949–50 Tercera División|1949–50 season]] of the third division, the regional champions of Gran Canaria and Tenerife were placed alongside 4 top teams from the Tercera División in the "Final Phase", and the top two teams from this group would advance to the second tier. Las Palmas performed well enough in the group to win promotion, but Tenerife fell far short, only winning a single match and losing both games against Las Palmas. This promotion system was abolished the next year, and the two would not meet again until 1953. == Stadia == === UD Las Palmas === Since 2003, UD Las Palmas play their home games at the [[Estadio Gran Canaria]] which has a capacity of 31,250. Located in the island's capital city of [[Las Palmas de Gran Canaria|Las Palmas]], the stadium is the biggest in the Canary Islands. In 2007 it hosted a [[Spain national football team|Spain]] international friendly against [[Northern Ireland national football team|Northern Ireland]], which Spain won 1-0 with a goal from [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]]. === CD Tenerife === CD Tenerife play their home games at the [[Estadio Heliodoro Rodríguez López]] which holds 23,000. Located in the island's capital city of [[Santa Cruz de Tenerife|Santa Cruz]], it has hosted four Spain internationals, against [[Germany national football team|Germany]], [[Switzerland national football team|Switzerland]], [[Poland national football team|Poland]] and [[Slovakia national football team|Slovakia]] respectively. == Head to head == As of 7 January 2024, there have been 75 official Canary Island derbies. 26 were drawn, UD Las Palmas won 28, and CD Tenerife won 21. === Las Palmas stats === * Wins: 28 * Draws: 26 * Defeats: 21 * Goals scored: 85 * Goals conceded: 74 === Tenerife stats === * Wins: 21 * Draws: 26 * Defeats: 28 * Goals scored: 74 * Goals conceded: 85 ==All-time results== '''League''' {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;
